summary: Move shared values like ansible_network_os and ansible_user into group vars to reduce duplication.
questions: How do I avoid repeating the network OS for every device?

answer_card.title: Group variables for network devices
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
leafs:
  hosts:
    leaf01: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.11 }
    leaf02: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.12 }
  vars:
    ansible_network_os: vyos.vyos.vyos
    ansible_user: my_vyos_user
```
